_doc: WON KNOBBER — Bypass dim-state tokens (Design-canonical, 2026-06-02). CC wires these as swappable tokens for §3.4. Goal: bypass reads as the unit losing power — a global cool de-energize, NOT a colour change. I/O meters keep moving (signal still passes); everything that signifies PROCESSING goes cold.

transition._note: Same curve both directions (engage<->bypass). No bounce.

panel_wash._what: Full-face overlay that de-energizes the whole chassis.
panel_wash._note: Cool blue-grey multiply over the panel + a slight global desaturate. This is the master 'offline' cue; everything below is layered on top so individual elements read correctly through the wash.

leds._note: Power / Sig / Clip all go fully dark — no fill, no box-shadow glow. The single clearest 'no power' tell.

scopes._note: Transfer curve + harmonics drop to 25% AND freeze on last frame — no live motion. Frozen+dim = not processing.

value_arc._note: Amber knob arc fades to a dull grey-amber at 15%. Knob cap itself unaffected (it's hardware).

gem._note: Hero stone desaturates ~50% and loses specular highlight life — a cold stone. Keep it visible (~85% bright), just lifeless.

db_readout._note: Dims to a dull ember; still legible. No amber glow.

io_meters._note: CRITICAL EXCEPTION — meters KEEP MOVING, recoloured neutral grey. Audio still flows (true bypass = dry passthrough), so monitoring stays alive while processing goes cold. This is what separates 'bypassed' from 'crashed'.

_static_note: Engraved metal + hardware don't dim — they're physical, not powered. Only the lit/active/processing layers de-energize.
